scope: Disposable approximately 733 MiB configured text-log corpus; same host, no retained deployment mutation or host cache drop
interpretation: Terminal means complete within captured configured browse retention or explicitly partial due to result/line/source/deadline bounds. Dense searches may stop at the result cap and must never claim a complete count. First sparse target includes a late-inventory match. CPU and file-read bytes are measured and reported, with at most two workers and one captured-corpus read per uncapped query; no additional arbitrary CPU threshold is invented after measurement.
coldEquivalent: A new independent corpus copy plus POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on only owned disposable files where supported; report actual /proc I/O evidence, never assert host caches were globally cold.
